name: finch-ocr
description: Read text out of images and screenshots with a local, offline OCR engine — no API key, no cloud upload.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx @finchtoys/minitools doctor .

finch.name: OCR
finch.description: Recognize text in images and screenshots, fully offline after the first run.
finch.systemPrompt: Use ocr_read_image to recognize text in a local image file or an http(s) image URL, powered by ppu-paddle-ocr running as a standalone offline engine. action=recognize (default) returns plain text or structured JSON with per-line boxes and confidence; action=detect only returns text-region bounding boxes; action=status reports whether the engine binary for this OS/arch is installed; action=clear_cache removes the cached engine so the next call re-downloads it. The first recognize/detect call on a machine downloads a platform-specific engine binary (tens of MB) and a small OCR model (a few MB); after that everything runs locally offline with no further network access. There is currently no engine build for Intel-based macOS (darwin x64) — Apple Silicon, Linux and Windows x64 are supported.
